interlock_info: A generator interlock kit mounts on the breaker panel front cover and consists of two sliding metal or plastic plates held together by three bolts. Slid down, it blocks the generator backfeed breaker while the main breaker can stay on; slid up, the backfeed breaker can be turned on but the main is blocked, preventing backfeed into utility lines that could harm line workers or damage equipment. Selection is two steps: (1) identify your breaker panel brand, (2) pick the corresponding GenInterlock kit.
